evidence: Varr. LL 6.85: mantēlium, ubi manūs terguntur
terms.comment: The hand towel; later also a tablecloth.
Traupman’s word; only Isidore has it.

phrases.latin: Postrēmō Theodōrus epitonium, quod ipse verterat, ipse clausit ōsque mantēlī tersit.
phrases.english: Finally Theo turned off the tap he had turned on himself and wiped his mouth on the hand towel.

towels.html: The hand towel is mantēle: Varr. LL 6.85 mantēlium, ubi manūs terguntur; Verg. A. 1.702. Not manutergium, which only Isidore has.

sources: Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word.
